sources.title: Tutel: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts at Scale
sources.actual_read: Re-read §3.1.1–3.1.2 and Figs6–8/Table4 discussion, §3.3 overview; not a new full evaluation reading.
sources.evidence: Single distributed weight layout and adaptive:r permit changing parallelism without layout reformatting. DP/MP group choices use different within-group all-gathers, repeated inputs and final sums.
sources.boundary: Direct prior for runtime parallel-degree selection on shared parameters. Does not show the inspected NAND same-base resident short/long row-prefix mechanism; runtime all-gather is substantive and cannot be assumed free in NAND.

sources.title: Official Tutel adaptive expert implementation
sources.actual_read: README adaptive descriptions; impls/moe_layer.py initialization/adaptive:r and forward lines125–143,328–357; experts/ffn.py constructor and forward lines83–119. No GPU run.
sources.evidence: forward accepts adaptive_r. ffn.py invokes zero_gather for both projections when DP/group gathering is required. valid_rs and hidden-size divisibility constrain the current implementation.
sources.boundary: Executable official GPU implementation exists. Snapshot is current main, not claimed identical to 2023 artifact. No inspected physical NAND prefix-image allocator.

sources.title: AnchorTP: Resilient LLM Inference with State-Preserving Elastic Tensor Parallelism
sources.actual_read: Re-read §III-A–C/Algorithm1/Fig3, implementation and discussion excerpts; not full evaluation or a verified author-code execution.
sources.evidence: Unequal floor/ceil shards over arbitrary GPU counts. Daemon preserves contiguous parameters; interval intersections generate Transfer tasks and missing ranges Reload tasks.
sources.boundary: Direct prior for retaining common rows during TP reshaping, but it performs migration/reload in a freeze window. Does not establish statically resident zero-migration prefix alternatives selected per routed query.

sources.title: ElasticMoE: An Efficient Auto Scaling Method for Mixture-of-Experts Models
sources.actual_read: Read §4.1,4.4–4.6, §5 lifecycle overview, AppendixC limitation and D.1/D.4–D.5/E details; not all evaluation or code.
sources.evidence: TP explicitly stays fixed while DP/EP change. Shared HBM IPC references and virtual physical-page mappings reduce duplicate allocation; P2P moves expert weights during scaling.
sources.boundary: A primary system implementation of shared-memory configurations, but not evidence of different expert TP degrees or static NAND prefix images.

sources.title: RFC: Efficient Runtime-Reconfiguration of Parallelization Configuration of MoE Models
sources.actual_read: Entire issue body, status and milestone/development metadata; official API response saved.
sources.evidence: Proposes concurrent different-TP instances sharing weights via HMM. TP dense/MoE support listed as M4/M5 milestones. Issue is open, with no linked branches/PRs in visible metadata.
sources.boundary: Specific author/developer proposal, not verified merged implementation or a demonstrated same-base prefix solver. Broader shared weights across parallel configurations cannot be claimed first.

sources.title: Ein Replikationsschema für multiple Fragmentierungen mit überlappenden Fragmenten
sources.actual_read: Fresh read §2.1 correctness, §3 introduction/§3.1 Definition2/examples/formulation and §3.2–3.3 overview in downloaded official proceedings; not an experimental reproduction.
sources.evidence: Different horizontal fragmentations share tuple intersections; tuple-level redundancy can be less than independently replicating complete fragments. Models capacity/conflicts and optional fragmentation constraints.
sources.boundary: Direct prior for multiple overlapping physical fragmentations and duplicate minimization. Does not enforce one dense contiguous prefix per device or NAND setup/page work; reconstruction can combine fragment intersections. PDF footer2015 conflicts with official2016 proceedings date, retained as previously noted.

sources.title: Query-Log Aware Replicated Declustering
sources.actual_read: Reused earlier primary reading documented in route-boundary-view-audit/sources.json: §2 and3.1–3.2. Fresh web request timed out; no new fulltext reading claimed.
sources.evidence: Private/shared item decomposition, selective replicas under storage budgets, and query-dependent replica scheduling are established.
sources.boundary: Strong native-adapted packet placement/selector control; independent item choices must be coupled into coherent A/B prefixes and charged native commands/inputs, not assumed feasible for free.

sources.title: Lower Bounds for Total Storage of Multiset Combinatorial Batch Codes Using Linear Programming
sources.actual_read: Read abstract/introduction and §II-A Definitions1–2 and example3 (pp255–257); no later LP constructions proof read.
sources.evidence: Replication-based set systems minimize total storage while providing restricted per-server parallel retrieval of requested symbols.
sources.boundary: Direct combinatorial storage/retrieval precedent. Its item-wise retrieval budget is not one-prefix, complete-expert GU/Down causal execution or integer page/setup service. Do not transfer its bounds without compound-query/prefix constraints.

sources.title: HDA-MoE: Hybrid Parallelism and Dynamic, Adaptive Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts with 3D Near-Memory Processing
sources.actual_read: Prior primary reading/code audit reused from coupled-closest-prior/sources.json, not a fresh fulltext/code reread.
sources.evidence: Per-expert fractional P_ic allocations, capacity/load optimization and coactivation-related communication objective; inspected code has no GU/Down phase axis or row-address replica-view registry.
sources.boundary: Direct heterogeneous-sharding/placement prior. Inspected formulation does not establish resident multiple-geometry prefix replicas; this is narrower than asserting HDA cannot express any such extended optimization.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.actual_read: Re-read local paper/aif.txt §4.4/Fig14 and §5.2 with prior numerical/streaming audit limits retained.
sources.evidence: Dense command input dimension/block/offset/page count, sequential matrix stream and output FIFO; equal-submatrix stock aif_post.
sources.boundary: Shared-prefix aliases/rowID scatter require controller/compiler metadata. Output scale/type, useful-row semantics, partial-row reset and finite FIFO/flow control remain unverified; two-view algebra does not prove the native ABI.
